fields.title: Automate routing of incoming claims to adjusters
fields.problem_statement: Every incoming claim is read and routed by hand before an adjuster can touch it; about 2 days from receipt to assignment at roughly 1,200 claims per week.
fields.current_workflow: Open each PDF, copy the policy number and loss type into a spreadsheet, then decide whether it goes to property, auto, or the complex queue.
fields.pain_points: Manual and error prone; formats vary from broker to broker; half the fields are re-keyed.
fields.cycle_time_today: About 2 days from receipt to assignment
fields.data_shape: PDF claim forms whose columns vary by broker; routing table in Snowflake
fields.what_was_tried: A vendor rules engine last year
fields.why_it_failed: Rules were brittle; broker forms change columns every quarter and the mapping had to be rebuilt; people stopped using it within three months.
fields.constraints: Must not send claimant PII to any external model; compliance review of data handling; shared auth token across three services must be fixed before automation writes.
fields.success_criteria: Same-day assignment; 80% of claims routed automatically with a confidence score and adjusters check the rest; 2 days to a few hours.
fields.adoption_risk: Adjusters won't use it if they can't see why a claim was routed; trust after the last tool; needs the reason and an override.
fields.security_or_data_use: Claimant PII must stay internal; a shared auth token across services is a security risk.
fields.timeline: Pilot by the end of Q1
fields.open_questions: Whether the second region can join at the same time; confirm with their director.
